description: Set up the test environment: install backend dependencies and verify existing tests pass before adding new ones.
steps: Install production deps: cd apps/backend && pip install -r requirements.txt
Install test deps: pip install pytest pytest-asyncio pytest-env pytest-cov
Run existing tests to confirm baseline: python -m pytest tests/test_chat.py tests/test_english_chat_integration.py -v
If any failures, report them in findings but do NOT fix them - just confirm the test infrastructure works
acceptance_criteria: pytest can be invoked and discovers tests
Existing chat-related tests (test_chat.py, test_english_chat_integration.py) run without import errors
verification: cd apps/backend && eval "$(pyenv init -)" && pyenv shell 3.11.15 && python -m pytest tests/test_chat.py tests/test_english_chat_integration.py -v --tb=short 2>&1 | tail -30
findings: All 19 existing tests pass (9 in test_chat.py, 10 in test_english_chat_integration.py). Python 3.11.15 via pyenv. All production and test deps already installed. pytest-asyncio 1.4.0 with asyncio mode=auto. No import errors or failures. Baseline is clean.
